spanish_col.markdown:
#### Capítulo VI de las demás casas deste signo, unas prósperas, otras adversas, otras indiferentes 

La tercera casa deste signo se llama _ei atl_. Decían que era indiferente, o bien o mal afortunada, porque cualquiera que nacía en este día, que sería rico y próspero y tendría mucha hacienda, que ganaría por su trabajo, y que lo perdería presto, y se desharía como agua o como cosas que lleva el río. Y nunca saldría con nada ni tendría reposo ni contento; todo se le desharía entre las manos y todo su trabajo saldría en vano.

spanish_col.markdown:
#### Sixth chapter: On the other houses of this sign, some prosperous, some negative, and others indifferent

The third house of this sign is called Yei Atl. They said that it was indifferent, either lucky or unlucky, because whoever was born on this day would become rich and prosperous; and he would have lots of property that he would earn through his own efforts, but he would lose it all right away, for it would all melt away like water or like things that the river carries away. And he would never accomplish anything, nor would he ever find rest or contentment; everything would dissolve in his hands, and all his labors would be in vain.

#### Sixth Chapter, which telleth of still another house on the sign [One Deer], called Three Water. It was in part good, in part adverse, in part only in between.

On the day sign Three Water, there was said to be good and ill.

For he who was born on it, so it was said, would prosper. All his wealth would come easily. He would be successful in gaining a living.

But, on the other hand, quickly would vanish that which had come to him. Like water it would pass away—as if carried off by the river, as if engulfed by the water. Never was he content; never happy.
